title: Jesus, Brightness of the Father
description: Jesus, Brightness of the Father in Tonic Solfa to KALMAR, doh is G: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 3 verses and a piano.
about: Rabanus Maurus wrote these words in Latin. Edward Caswall's translation was printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (St. Louis, 1927), as hymn 287.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked 8.7.8.7.7.7, to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to KALMAR; any other 8.7.8.7.7.7 tune fits them as well.
underlay: Je-sus, Bright-ness of the Fa-ther, Life and Strength of all who live! In the pre-sence of the an-gels Glo-ry in Thy name we give: And Thy won-drous praise re-hearse, Sing-ing in har-mo-nious verse.

lines: Life and Strength of all who live!
In the presence of the angels
Glory in Thy name we give:
Shelter us from harm this day;
Keep us pure in flesh and spirit;
Save us from the Foe, we pray:
And vouchsafe us by Thy grace
Sing we with the heavenly host;
Three in One, and One in Three,

licence: Public domain: Rabanus Maurus died in 856; Edward Caswall died in 1878.
credits: Words by Rabanus Maurus (died 856), translated by Edward Caswall (1814–1878), public domain, as printed in the Evangelical Lutheran Hymn-Book (1927); set to KALMAR by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
